- Every optional-capability module (`voice.py`, `vision.py`, `tts.py`, `gmail_client.py`) follows the same two-tier shape: a low-level function that *can* raise (e.g. `capture_photo`, `describe_image`, `list_recent_emails`) and a high-level wrapper that never raises, catching all exceptions and returning a `"<module>: <error>"` string (e.g. `voice.transcribe`, `vision.describe_scene`, `gmail_client.describe_recent_emails`). New capabilities should follow this split, not just wrap everything in one function.
- External clients/models are built through a module-level lazy singleton function (`_get_model()`, `_get_client()`, `_get_service()`) that is the sole monkeypatch seam in tests — never call the real SDK constructor inline in a function you want testable.
- `VisionBuffer`/`AudioBuffer`/`BufferWatcher` share one shape: constructor takes an injectable factory (`camera_factory`, `microphone_factory`, `get_latest`/`describe`/`on_result`), explicit `start()`/`stop()`/`is_running()`, a background `threading.Thread(daemon=True)`, and `stop()` always joins with a timeout — mirror this shape for any new continuous-capture feature.
- CLI commands in `jarvis.py::handle()` are plain-text French verb phrases matched via `looks_like_local_command()` (exact-match set + prefix tuple) before falling through to the agentic LLM loop — new commands must be registered in both the exact-match/prefix lists AND the `HELP_TEXT` constant, or they'll silently route to the LLM instead of the fast local path.
- New agentic tools are added in three places kept in sync: the `AGENTIC_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTIONS` tool list docstring, `Jarvis.execute_agent_tool()`'s dispatch, and (if it should also be reachable via plain text) `handle()`.
- Never trigger real side-effecting network/hardware calls from a `pytest` test — always monkeypatch the seam function. A past bug: a test that sent `confirm: true` through the HTTP backend actually called the real `webbrowser.open()` and popped a real browser tab on every `pytest` run.
